your_book:
Tuesday's session was a drag on Jaleel's book, with the majority of holdings finishing in the red. The heaviest damage came from SAP, which shed 4.01% — the single worst performer on the day — followed by Danaher (−3.1%) and Adobe (−2.29%). NVIDIA fell another 1.51%, consistent with the broader semiconductor pullback flagged in today's headlines ahead of its earnings report; at a 9.6% weight, that move carries real portfolio-level consequence. On the bright side, Novartis surged 6.04%, Gilead added 2.45%, and Expand Energy climbed 1.85%, providing partial offset. SPGI ticked up 1.0% on notable institutional activity. The book's overall unrealized gain stands at 2.65%.

The drift picture is where the real tension sits. Rocket Lab carries a verdict of AVOID yet remains a 6.3% weight and is now down 20.2% — price and thesis are moving in opposite directions with no sign of stabilization. BSX and AZN are both rated STRONG BUY but are sitting in the red on an unrealized basis, meaning the fundamental case has yet to be validated by price. LULU is rated HOLD-QUAL, down 7.7% overall, and has a guidance-cut risk flag with an earnings catalyst just two days out on September 3 — the window to act is narrow.

Watch ADBE closely: earnings land September 10, the AI-disruption narrative is driving the stock despite solid fundamentals, and today's 2.29% drop keeps the pressure on. SAP's 4.01% single-session drop from a relatively small weight is unusual enough to warrant a look at whether there's a news catalyst driving it. The pharma cluster — GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX — faces a persistent drug-pricing policy overhang that today's NVS pop doesn't resolve.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated position down 20.2% with no thesis support
attention.note: Rocket Lab carries the book's lowest QARP score (39.4) and an AVOID verdict, yet it remains a 6.3% weight with losses deepening — the case for continued holding needs an explicit, documented reason or the position warrants exit.

attention.headline: Guidance-cut risk flag with earnings in 2 days (Sep 3)
attention.note: Americas comps are negative for a fifth straight quarter, tariffs have hit margins, and China is stalled — the earnings event on September 3 could crystallize further downside with almost no time left to reduce exposure.

attention.headline: Largest single-day drop in the book at −4.01%
attention.note: A 4.01% move from a BUY-rated name with no accompanying headline in the data warrants checking for a catalyst — earnings pre-announcement, macro read-through, or currency impact on the ADR.

attention.headline: AI-narrative selloff continues ahead of Sep 10 earnings
attention.note: The stock is down again today despite a HOLD-QUAL rating on solid fundamentals, and the CFO exit plus AI-moat fear could turn a beat-and-raise into another sell-the-news event — positioning ahead of September 10 deserves a deliberate call.
